* '''PC-E1''' ([[Scomp Link Access (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1261_100">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock6Type (Virtual Block 6 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “USED: ▲ a non-[Episode I] droid (except IL-19). OR Place a card from hand on Used Pile. STARTING: ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. If you have only one location (with less than 3 [Light Side Force]) (except Massassi Throne Room) on table, may ▼ a [Cloud City] site. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' “< 3” is written out as “less than 3”. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Scomp Link Access (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-scomplinkaccess-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual6-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “USED: a ▲ non-[Episode I] droid (except IL-19). OR Place a card from hand on Used Pile. STARTING: ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. If you have only one location (with < 3 [Light Side Force]) (except Massassi Throne Room) on table, may ▼ a [Cloud City] site. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' “less than 3” is “< 3” again, and the first sentence reads “USED: a ▲ non-” (the release sheet has “USED: ▲ a non-”). Lee Edwards' V-kit of 9 December 2009 has a copy of this slip with the release-sheet words (“USED: ▲ a non-”)<ref name="vkit-2009">Lee Edwards' V-kit, [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips swccgvkit-legacy <code>public/images/vslips</code>] (commit 81e0048, migrated from svn on 28 May 2010; the <code>.svn/entries</code> files record svn r1 committed 2009-12-09T05:41:52Z for these slips). The file <code>virtual18-light/scomplinkaccess.png</code> prints “USED: ▲ a non-” (the release-sheet order), not the PC card image wording, compared by eye on 11 November 2026.</ref>, so this image is not the 2009 one and is dated by its server upload. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date). Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and set mark) and prints slip number “101” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does. It draws the Episode I icon as a plain round cross, where the release-sheet slip prints the “EPISODE I” disc.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=36 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1261-100-front-master.png]]: “USED: ▲ a non-[Episode I] droid (except IL-19). OR Place a card from hand on Used Pile. STARTING: ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. If you have only one location (with < 3 [Light Side Force]) (except Massassi Throne Room) on table, may ▼ a [Cloud City] site. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the release-sheet words again, word for word (“USED: ▲ a non-”, “< 3”). It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (versions rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat; whatever was published last is current). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
